name: Leading Edge Manufacturing, LLC
old_description: “They have treated me as a valued customer as I grew my business, and now we run thousands of pieces per year versus the few hundred per year when I first came to them. I highly recommend Leading Edge for your custom fabrication needs.”
about:
Edge Manufacturing, LLC operates from Youngsville, Louisiana, with an additional facility in Broussard. The company was founded in June 1994 in a 2,500‑square‑foot shop on the banks of the Vermilion River. Steve Himel became sole owner in 2008 after purchasing his partner’s share, and leadership transitioned to his daughter Stephanie Clotiaux, who was named chief operating officer in 2017 and CEO in 2021.

The shop provides custom metal fabrication services including design and drafting using CAD/CAM, CNC machining, welding and fabrication, finishing, in‑house powder coating, and inspection and quality control. Production takes place in a 26,000‑square‑foot facility in Youngsville, and the company states it manufactures most parts in‑house to maintain quality standards.

Edge serves the oil and gas, maritime, power distribution, accommodations, and HVAC industries. Its customer base includes regional managers, project managers, engineers, and CEOs who have relied on the company for periods ranging from ten to fourteen years, with one client noting volume growth from a few hundred to thousands of pieces per year.

The company emphasizes a ‘Quality · Service · Integrity’ philosophy, promoting competitive pricing, timely deliveries, and a proven quality system. It was started to deliver solutions that improve quality while reducing lead times, and it highlights its in‑house capabilities and local Gulf Coast presence as key differentiators.

name: Lectron Industries
old_description: Lectron Industries is an electronic parts wholesale distributor. If you are a manufacturer, we have the semiconductors and electronic parts for your power, repair, medical, and testing equipment. With more than 45 years of experience in the industry, our technical expertise means that we will always have the solution for your needs.
about:
Lectron Industries was founded in 1981 in Union, New Jersey, by a former U.S. Air Force radar technician who served on the F-4 Phantom, including a tour in Vietnam. After leaving the service, he worked for a semiconductor testing and sales company before launching his own wholesale distribution business.

The company operates as a wholesale distributor of power and discrete semiconductors, supplying electronic components to manufacturers of power, repair, medical, and testing equipment. Lectron does not manufacture parts itself; instead, it sources from a network of quality manufacturers and provides technical expertise to match components to application requirements.

Its customer base consists primarily of original equipment manufacturers in the power electronics, medical device, test and measurement, and repair sectors. The distributor serves clients nationwide and worldwide from its Union, New Jersey facility.

Lectron emphasizes its founder’s hands-on technical background and more than 45 years of industry experience as the foundation for its ability to deliver reliable, high-quality semiconductor solutions. Membership in the Union Township Chamber of Commerce reflects its local business roots.

name: Lee's Foodservice Parts & Repairs
old_description: Welcome to Lee’s Foodservice Parts & Repairs, Inc. Since 1998, we’ve been providing commercial foodservice and commercial kitchen repair, installation and maintenance in the Chicago, SE and SW Wisconsin and Northwest Indiana areas.
about:
Lee's Foodservice Parts & Repairs, Inc. is based in Addison, Illinois, and has served the Midwest since 1998. The business began as the Howard Transport Company, providing delivery and warehousing for the foodservice industry, before evolving into Lee's Oven Repair and later expanding into a full-service repair, installation, and maintenance provider for commercial kitchens.

The company repairs, installs, and maintains a wide range of commercial foodservice equipment, including ovens, fryers, ranges, grills, steamers, kettles, ice machines, refrigerators, freezers, and walk-in coolers. It also offers commercial HVAC and refrigeration services, and sells new and used equipment. Technicians operate from specialized truck stock inventories and have access to over $5 million in parts, supporting a first-time fix rate that exceeds industry standards.

Lee's serves restaurants, institutional kitchens, and facilities-management firms across the Chicago metro area, southeastern and southwestern Wisconsin, northwestern Indiana, and the Indianapolis region. Customers include large foodservice manufacturers and companies such as Facilities Services, Inc. The firm positions itself as a single source for HVAC, refrigeration, and kitchen equipment needs.

Founded to address the need for reliable, around-the-clock kitchen support, Lee's differentiates itself with extended service hours (6 AM to 5 PM), 24/7 emergency response, a 30-day labor warranty and 90-day parts warranty, and a guaranteed response time. The company aims to be a one-stop shop so clients do not need separate contractors for HVAC, refrigeration, and kitchen equipment.

name: Legends Home
old_description: For nearly 40 years, Legends Home has built its reputation on doing things the right way. From our Arizona manufacturing floor to our global sourcing network, we focus on quality, speed, and reliability so our dealers can count on us every time. We’ve grown, expanded, and evolved, but our approach hasn’t changed: when it matters most, we show up, follow through, and make it right.
about:
Legends Home operates from Tolleson, Arizona, where it was founded in 1991. The company maintains a domestic manufacturing floor in the state while also managing a global sourcing network for imported goods. Ownership details and founder names are not publicly disclosed.

The company produces residential furniture collections spanning entertainment, bedroom, and upholstery categories, including living room and dining pieces. It operates two production streams: domestic manufacturing at its Arizona facility and imported production through its global sourcing network. Specific facility size, headcount, annual volumes, and part counts are not disclosed.

Legends Home sells exclusively to furniture dealers, positioning itself as a partner that provides trend-right, value-driven collections backed by reliable inventory and consistent delivery. Its dealer network represents the primary customer base, with the company emphasizing competitive cost and dependable quality to help dealers sell more and grow faster.

The company's stated differentiation rests on its GRIT operating philosophy—Growth, Resilience, Integrity, and Teamwork—and a “We Make It Right” commitment that includes a 100% satisfaction guarantee, U.S. shipping, and a focus on showing up and following through for dealers. It cites over 35 years in business and more than 20,000 reviews as evidence of its approach.

name: Legere Group Ltd
old_description: Legere is a manufacturer of commercial and institutional millwork, as well as your turnkey provider of interior architectural metal and glass, stretch fabric, and stone. We have been fabricating and installing millwork since 1975. We provide millwork, metal, glass, stone, and stretch fabric to project locations extending from Northern, NJ to Boston, MA. As one of the largest full service custom architectural millwork manufacturers in the U.S., we focus on large scopes of work that range in value from $1 million to over $12 million. Our key to success is our continued pursuit of excellence, driven by our desire to produce what others deem the impossible. Whether your project requires just millwork items, or a complete package of millwork, glass, metal, stone, and stretch fabric, we are here to help you through the process of making a concept a reality. Don’t forget to ask us about our experience with IPD design build projects and our FSC® products.
about:
Founded in 1975 in Avon, Connecticut, Legere Group Ltd began as a millwork fabricator and installer serving commercial and institutional projects across the Northeast.

The company operates a 177,000-square-foot manufacturing facility where union shop and field personnel produce custom architectural millwork, cabinetry, and one-of-a-kind fabrications. Its engineering team creates detailed shop drawings, CNC code, and 3D models following AWI standards, while the architectural metal and glass division supplies smoke baffles, glass railings, stair railings, back-painted glass, mirrors, marker boards, and engineered office-front systems. Project scopes typically range from $300,000 to more than $12 million.

Legere serves commercial construction, institutional construction, and design-build clients from northern New Jersey to Boston, Massachusetts. The firm packages millwork with metal, glass, stretch fabric, and stone to provide turnkey interior architectural solutions, and it has experience with integrated project delivery (IPD) design-build projects.

The company emphasizes self-performed installation—maintaining its own crews for local work and vetted subcontractors elsewhere—to engineer products for streamlined assembly and tight installation windows. It also offers Forest Stewardship Council (FSC®) certified products and supports LEED compliance for sustainable building goals.

name: Leonard Metal Fabricators Inc
old_description: We have been in business since 1966 and have a 75,000+ sq.ft. manufacturing facility. We have fabricated metal for 400 different clients and have many long term customers because they know and trust the quality of our services.
about:
Leonard Metal Fabricators Inc was founded in 1966 in Pearl, Mississippi. The company operates a 75,000-square-foot manufacturing facility and has served over 400 clients since its inception.

The shop provides full-service custom sheet metal fabrication, including precision shearing, laser cutting, bending, welding, polishing, and powder coating. It works with aluminum, stainless steel, abrasion-resistant alloys, carbon steel, and perforated or expanded metals. Typical output ranges from tanks, non-code vessels, and piping to structural steel, platforms, appliance components, complex weldments, conveyors, chain guards, cabinets, concrete molds, and machine frames. The facility also runs ERP, CAD, CAM, and CRM systems to manage orders and offers just-in-time inventory storage for customers.

Leonard Metal serves local, regional, and national customers across industries such as appliance manufacturing, material handling, construction, and general industrial equipment. Its product examples include appliance components, conveyor systems, storage tanks, and structural steel assemblies.

The company emphasizes precision and attention to detail, citing significant recent investments in equipment and technology. It positions itself as a long-term precision sheet metal partner and differentiates itself with in-house powder coating and a just-in-time inventory program that reduces customers’ storage costs.

name: Leonard Truck Outfitters
old_description: Leonard Truck Outfitters is your local home for truck accessories, trailers, sheds, and outdoor storage buildings in Princeton, WV. For tough jobs, weekend adventures, or customized upgrades, Leonard Truck Outfitters has you covered. Since 1963, Leonard has been the trusted name for utility trailers, truck toppers, spray-in bed liners, storage sheds, and outdoor buildings. Whether you need to tow your toys for the weekend away, set up a new shop in an outbuilding, or upgrade your truck, Leonard Truck Outfitters carries the top brands and installs everything we sell — fast, professionally, and with local know-how.
about:
Leonard Truck Outfitters operates in Princeton, West Virginia, and has been serving the area since 1963. The business began as a provider of utility trailers, truck toppers, spray-in bed liners, storage sheds, and outdoor buildings.

The company sells and installs a range of truck accessories, trailers, and storage buildings. It carries brands such as LEER truck caps, BAK and Roll-N-Lock tonneau covers, and WeatherTech floor mats. Services include trailer hitch installation, spray-in bed liner application, trailer repair and parts, and shed delivery and setup. The Princeton location at 200 Expert Circle also offers financing for trailers and rent-to-own options for sheds. Additional stores operate in Beckley, West Virginia, and Blacksburg and Roanoke, Virginia.

Customers include individual truck owners, commercial fleets, contractors, farmers, and recreational users. The shop outfits Ford, Dodge, Ram, Toyota, GMC, Chevrolet, and Nissan trucks, and provides volume pricing for fleet customers. Trailer lines cover utility, cargo, dump, equipment, car hauler, ATV, livestock, and flatbed models. Shed offerings span wooden, metal, and vinyl structures, including garages, carports, and animal shelters.

Leonard Truck Outfitters emphasizes local expertise, professional installation of every product sold, and after-sale support through its trailer service department. The company was founded to provide a one-stop source for hauling and storage needs backed by hands-on service.

name: Les Hall Filter USA (Formerly Oil Filter Service)
old_description: Les Hall Filter has been a leading supplier of heavy duty filters, hydraulic hose and fittings since 1959. With a combined experience of over 150 years in the field of industrial filtration, hydraulic hoses and fittings, our team of experts are capable of providing cost effective solutions for virtually any filtration or hydraulic application.
about:
Les Hall Filter USA operates from Portland, Oregon, tracing its roots to 1959 when Navy engineer Les Hall retired and began supplying industrial products to commercial marine operators on the docks of Vancouver, British Columbia. The business remained privately held after Hall’s death in 1971 and later merged with Oil Filter Service, a Pacific Northwest company founded in 1946 that specialized in filtration and high-performance hydraulic hose and fittings. The combined entity, Les Hall Filter USA, continues as a privately owned distributor.

The company supplies heavy-duty filters, hydraulic hose, fittings, adapters, and filtration equipment. Services include fleet surveys to catalog equipment needs, custom kit assembly for service intervals, custom packaging and labeling, on-site customer inventory management, dedicated account management with representatives averaging 20 years of experience, guaranteed stocking of critical parts, custom part numbering for resellers, and tailored reporting and billing.

Customers span logging, construction, marine, and manufacturing operations, as well as industrial supply houses, automotive repair shops, and marine dealers. The firm’s fleet surveys and inventory programs serve commercial vessel operators, heavy-equipment fleets, and manufacturing facilities throughout the Pacific Northwest.

Les Hall Filter USA emphasizes its regional inventory breadth, vendor consolidation, and guaranteed availability of critical components as key differentiators. The company was built to combine deep technical expertise with a broad product assortment to compete against larger multinationals while maintaining personalized service.

name: Lester Electrical-Nebraska Inc
old_description: Lester Electrical specializes in electrical power conversion and storage. In addition to battery chargers, we design and manufacture a variety of electrical power system products, including battery dischargers/testers, power management systems, and battery systems.
about:
Lester Electrical has designed and manufactured industrial battery chargers and electrical power solutions in Lincoln, Nebraska since 1963. The company began as a specialist in electrical power conversion and storage, building a reputation for charging expertise over more than six decades.

Today the firm produces switch‑mode (high‑frequency) battery chargers such as the 650 W Ascendrix and the 1,425 W and 650 W Summit Series II, along with battery dischargers/testers, power management systems and custom battery systems. It operates as an OEM and ODM supplier, describing itself as one of the industry’s highest‑volume manufacturers, though specific facility size and headcount are not disclosed.

Its customers span electric‑vehicle, motive‑power, stationary‑power, industrial‑automation and custom markets. Concrete applications include aerial work platforms, floor‑care equipment, golf cars, material‑handling vehicles, railroad signaling and utility infrastructure. The company works directly with equipment manufacturers, battery partners such as Trojan Battery Company, distributors and engineering teams.

Lester Electrical emphasizes value, quality and technology as its differentiators: a focus on long‑term cost efficiency, a tradition of reliability in demanding environments, and a history of pioneering charge‑control technology that now extends to modern communication and connectivity features.

name: Liberty Plastics Molding Corporation Inc.
old_description: We know plastics molding. Family owned and operated since 1973, Liberty Plastics Molding offers you over 50 years of experience in the mold building and plastic injection molding business. We can custom build aluminum and steel molds, perform the plastic injection mold process, and follow up with any secondary operations.
about:
Liberty Plastics Molding Corporation Inc. is a family-owned injection molding and mold building company based in Bellevue, Kentucky. Founded in 1973 as Liberty Products Inc. by Homer and Marlene Gemmer, the business began in a small building on Liberty Street in Newport, Kentucky. Homer Gemmer, formerly a model shop supervisor at a major toy manufacturer in the Cincinnati area, started a machine and mold shop that grew into injection molding. The company relocated to its current 56,000-square-foot facility in Bellevue on April 2, 1993.

The company operates 15 injection molding machines ranging from 75 to 550 tons, supporting both short and long production runs. In-house mold building covers aluminum and steel tooling, single or multi-cavity, from prototype to full production. Secondary operations and blanket order programs allow customers to avoid multi-sourcing and store parts for up to a year. Materials processed include high- and low-density polyethylene, polypropylene, HIPS, ABS, Delrin, nylon, polycarbonate, polyurethane, PVC (rigid and flexible), CPVC, and PVDF.

Liberty serves a broad range of sectors including conveyor and packaging, power and utility, bowling, chemical pump, casket, furniture, pet supply, towing and recovery, food, toy, medical, and automotive industries. Customers such as Wayne F. in conveyor and belting packaging, Tom V. across multiple industries, and Patrick F. in the bearing industry have relied on the company for made-to-order parts.

The Gemmer family’s multi-generational ownership — now led by third-generation President Jeff Jr. Gemmer and CFO Jaclyn Gemmer Thompson — emphasizes hands-on service and continuity. The company highlights its total in-house capabilities, central Midwest location for lower freight costs, and a commitment to quality, price, and delivery as key differentiators.
